C0.quote: the VAA provides a ranking ri ∈ R(C) based on these similarity
C0.note: The main object is a voting advice application. It is a recommender system that matches each individual voter to candidates by a distance between answer vectors and returns a personal ranking for that voter. It does not aggregate several agents' inputs into a collective decision by voting. The paper studies adversarial manipulation of these recommendations, not of a voting rule. Coding stopped per C0.
